samples.name: construction-stage-1-ground
samples.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Input is finished Stage building, edit target. Keep original square canvas, camera, platform footprint and ground anchor. Preserve empty upper space; do not zoom or recenter. Crisp 48x48 logical pixel art, shown enlarged. Warm brown wood, three flat shades per material, Kenney Tiny Town / Tiny Farm simplicity. Sharp square pixels. Transparent background including gaps. No halo, gradients, antialiasing, colored fringe, scenery, text or additional props.
